note: A dark room (roomLevel 0): a monitor in standby, and a headset stand beside it. TWO LEDs. (1) The monitor's standby LED at (370,659) settles a disagreement: Daniel reported it red, and it is amber. The app reads hue 42 and the magnified crop shows a golden-orange glow with a white-hot centre. The evidence that this is the light and not a bias in the pipeline is that 0006 and 0008 were shot the same night in the same darkness and their red LEDs came back at hue 1.2 and 1.3; the same code returns red when the light is red. (2) The blue point at (586,435) was recorded here as 'a white highlight on a headset' and counted as a false positive. That was wrong. Brightened 3x it is a small blue indicator on the black body of the stand, the app reads hue 208 at saturation 0.49 with 0.996 agreement, and a white highlight is by definition unsaturated. Nor can it be a reflection: the only other light in the room is a green strip, and a reflection takes the colour of what lights it. It is an LED, and it was being punished for finding one.
